description: Agent Mining Records: submit reclamation records, the post-mining restoration record, with the reclamation plan, bond entries and the mine record’s closure entries they answer to: the reading moment; each closure task the reclamation plan schedules with its id, reference, the closure work, the cost the plan estimates and the moment scheduled; each closure entry in the mine record with its id, reference, the task, whether it records the work complete and the moment recorded; each bond entry with its id, reference, the kind (posted or release), the amount, the closure task a release answers to and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the closure work and the records behind it, each scheduled task due against a closure entry, the bond posted against the plan’s own cost figures, each release against the completion of the work it answers to, and the releases against the bond posted, and counts them, and names divergent reclamation records: closure work the plan schedules with no closure entry behind it, a bond figure the plan’s own figures do not support, a bond release recorded before the closure work it answers to is recorded complete, and releases past the bond posted; then a closure entry naming work the plan does not schedule and a release naming no scheduled task, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No plan tasks, or no posted bond beside releases or costs, leaves those points unverified. Tasks, closures and bonds match by letters and digits, costs and bond figures to the hundredth, dates by the day, a release is met by a closure entry recording its task complete on or before the release date, and a task scheduled after the reading moment waits. This reads restoration of the mine site; a farm’s land and soil records stay with the Agent Agriculture Records family. Verdict reclamation_record_divergent, reclamation_record_partial, reclamation_record_unverified or reclamation_record_consistent. POST /api/mining-reclamation-record-check. Reads the mining records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it operates no mine, contacts no regulator, land office or other operator and issues no permit, claim or certification, which stay with the mine operator, the land office and the regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Mining Records reads mineral extraction records (hard-rock, coal, aggregate and quarry operations), not cryptocurrency mining and not data mining; the Agent Datasets family reads data sets. It reads a mine operator’s own records: mine records with operator licensing and certification entries, mining claim records for mineral land, mine permit records as issued, mine inspection records with citations and abatements, mine safety records with the blasting log, mining production records by period, the mine’s own tailings facility records and reclamation records with their bond entries, each against the permit, claim, production, certification, schedule, corrective action, shipment, capacity, closure and bond records it answers to. The family’s ground is the mine’s paper trail: what the mine record claims, whether the claims, permits and inspections hold up, what the safety and production records support, and whether the tailings and reclamation records line up; it reads by record holder and subject: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production and land records, the Agent Waste and Recycling Records family reads manifested waste and disposal records, wever_water-discharge-record-check reads mine effluent monitoring, and the Agent Claims family reads insurance claims, while this family reads the mine’s own records and reads none of those. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-mining-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-mining-records/.

amount.description: Amount of the bond entry, in the unit the record uses.

task.description: The closure task a release answers to reference.

closures.description: Each closure entry in the mine record.

complete.description: Whether the entry records the work complete.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

tasks.description: Each closure task the reclamation plan schedules.

cost.description: Amount the plan estimates, in the unit the record uses.

due_at.description: When the plan schedules it, such as 2026-03-02.
